accessDenied.title: No branding access
accessDenied.reason: Only the owner or an admin can change the brand and branches of {branch}.

header.title: Brand & branches
header.subtitle: The brand name, colors and default images for {restaurant}, plus its branches. Each branch sets its own logo and app icon in its Branch settings.

storefront.title: Default storefront look
storefront.description: The menu layout and hero every branch shows until it sets its own in Branch settings → Menu layout. A branch’s own look always wins.
storefront.heroTitleHint: Leave empty to use the default headline.
storefront.heroSubtitleHint: Leave empty to show “Now serving from '{branch}'”.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Locations under {restaurant}. Each gets its own storefront URL + QR code.
branches.seatsUsed: You are using {used} of {seats, plural, one {# branch seat} other {# branch seats}}. Add a seat to open another location — it gets the full feature set of your main branch.
branches.copyNote: A new branch can copy the menu, opening hours, payment, delivery and tax settings, the look and the loyalty programme of an existing one. Its map pin, table QR codes, payment QR, stock counts, staff and customers are never copied — set those up at the new branch.

brandList.empty: A brand holds the name that starts every storefront name, its colors, and a default logo and app icon for branches without their own. Each branch sets its own logo and app icon in <link>Branch settings</link>.
brandList.createHint: The brand starts with the name “{name}”. You can change the name, colors and default images right after.

errors.notAllowed: Only the restaurant owner or an admin can create the brand.

fields.name: Branch name
fields.slugHint: Part of the storefront web address. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
fields.timezoneHint: Opening hours, scheduling and daily reports use this zone. It starts on this device’s zone.

copy.menuHint: Categories, items, option groups and combos. Stock tracking starts off until you count stock there.
copy.hoursHint: The weekly hours, not one-off closures
copy.settingsHint: Payment methods, delivery, tips, service fee, sales tax, prep time, dine-in and scheduling
copy.notCopied: Address, map pin, logo, app icon, payment QR, stock counts, staff, customers, loyalty points and table QR codes are not copied.
copy.lookHint: Colours, menu layout and hero. Each branch uploads its own logo and app icon.
copy.qrNever: The payment QR is never copied: it is the other branch’s bank account. Bank transfer stays off at the new branch until it uploads its own QR.
copy.loyaltyHint: Points rate, tiers, perks and the rewards list. Members and their points stay at their own branch. A free-item reward needs the menu copied too.

errors.seats: {limit, plural, one {You are using your only branch seat.} other {You are using all # of your branch seats.}} Add a seat (+$99/mo) on the Plan page, then create the branch.
errors.inactive: Your subscription is not active. Choose a package on the Plan page to continue.
errors.notAuthorized: Only the owner or an admin can add a branch.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a branch name and a URL slug.
errors.slugTaken: Another branch already uses that URL slug. Choose a different one.
errors.noBranchId: The branch was created, but the reply did not say which branch it was, so nothing was copied into it. Close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.copyMenuNotEmpty: The branch was created, but copying from {source} failed: the new branch already has menu items. Untick “Copy menu” and retry to copy the rest, or close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.copyFailed: The branch was created, but copying from {source} failed. You can retry the copy, or close this and set the branch up in its own settings.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidSlug: The URL slug can use only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, 2 to 64 characters, like downtown-2.
errors.invalidTimezone: That time zone is not recognised. Pick one from the list.
errors.invalidTaxRate: The sales tax rate must be from 0% up to 50%.
errors.invalidBrand: That brand is not part of this restaurant. Choose another or none.
errors.copyNotAuthorized: The branch was created, but you are not allowed to copy from {source}. Close this and set the branch up in its own settings.

created.title: Branch created
created.menu: {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}, {items, plural, one {# menu item} other {# menu items}} and {groups, plural, one {# option group} other {# option groups}}
created.hours: {count, plural, one {# opening-hours window} other {# opening-hours windows}}
created.settingsCopied: Payment, delivery, tip, service fee, sales tax, prep time, dine-in and scheduling settings
created.settingsNone: No payment or delivery settings: the source branch has none saved
created.scheduleWindows: {count, plural, one {# booking window for scheduled orders} other {# booking windows for scheduled orders}}
created.empty: {name} starts empty: no menu, no opening hours (open around the clock) and the standard settings.
created.transferOff: Bank transfer is off here: the payment QR belongs to the other branch and was not copied. Upload this branch’s own QR in its settings, then switch transfer on.
created.stockOff: {count, plural, one {# item tracked stock at the source branch. Tracking is off here} other {# items tracked stock at the source branch. Tracking is off here}} until you count stock at the new branch.

todo.pin: Drop its map pin (delivery fees and riders are measured from it)
todo.tables: Set up its tables and print their QR codes
todo.paymentQr: Upload its own payment QR if it takes bank transfers
todo.stock: Count stock, then switch stock tracking on
todo.loyalty: Set up its loyalty programme and rewards

created.loyaltyCopied: {count, plural, =0 {The loyalty programme settings (no rewards)} one {The loyalty programme and # reward} other {The loyalty programme and # rewards}}
created.rewardsSkipped: {count, plural, one {# free-item reward was not copied because its dish was not copied. Create it again once the menu is in place.} other {# free-item rewards were not copied because their dishes were not copied. Create them again once the menu is in place.}}

editor.title: Edit brand
editor.name: Brand name
editor.nameHint: The first half of every branch’s storefront and app name, as in “{example}”.
editor.logoHint: Used only by branches without a logo of their own. Each branch uploads its own under Branch settings → Branding for this branch.
editor.appIconHint: Used only by branches without an app icon of their own, for the browser tab and the icon people see after installing. Each branch uploads its own under Branch settings. Leave empty to use the Favornoms icon.
editor.linkedHint: Choose which branches use this brand’s theme.
editor.setDefault: Set as default brand for this restaurant
editor.iconPending: Apply the new icon style first, or set it back.

errors.notSaved: That didn’t save — your role may not be allowed to change branding.
errors.slugTaken: Another brand already uses that slug.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You don’t have permission to do that.

shared.ownerOnly: Only the restaurant owner or an admin of every branch can change these shared settings. You can still add a branch.
